goal: Assess beginner usability and content depth across Home, Explore, Chat, Tarot, Astrology, Journal and Profile, including library and AI journeys, using scoped source review and a disconnected local preview; write a prioritized owner report without implementation changes.
successCriteria: Report distinguishes code_supported_risk, synthetic web observations, untested hypotheses and unverified native or live AI behavior.
Manager can understand priority, evidence, expected user benefit and a testable next slice for both library depth and AI follow-up quality.
Existing application, content, prompts, data contracts and dirty work remain unchanged; only this plan, the scoped report, scoped audit evidence and development caches may be written.
Any local preview uses disabled cloud endpoints and only newly created synthetic account or dev-only preview data; no real user records, secrets or private browser sessions are inspected.

writeScopeRestrictions.apps/mobile/: Development server and framework cache effects only. No application source, configuration, assets, dependency, native project or runtime code edits are authorized.
Parent-owned internal Vietnamese audit and proposed priority report.
writeScopeRestrictions.artifacts/ux-depth-audit-2026-10-14/: Parent-owned sanitized local preview evidence, screenshots and test notes only.

untouchedSurfaces: All mobile implementation source, configuration, static content, artwork and existing tests remain untouched.
Supabase projects, database, storage, RLS, migrations, runtime bindings, credentials and target allowlists remain untouched.
Both protected Admin workspaces, website, public Help/legal, payment providers, entitlements and release packages remain untouched.
No model generation, provider request, cloud sync, publication, deployment, notification delivery or external message is authorized.

impact.entryPoint: Inspect the existing five-tab mobile shell and library, reading and follow-up entry paths; dev-only mythology and chart-story fixture routes may be opened as separately labeled synthetic views.
impact.dataWrite: Write only the declared internal report and sanitized audit artifacts. Local preview may create disposable synthetic browser storage and development caches; do not modify existing user data or source files.
impact.backendContract: No backend contract changes or backend calls. Process-only environment disables dotenv loading and clears Supabase URL, anonymous key and Nilaza API URL before preview; preserve all repository env files.
impact.adminVisibility: No Admin access or changes. Report static content operations and AI depth implications without using protected records or live operator actions.
impact.privacySafety: Use a fresh synthetic local session, fictional nonsensitive questions and synthetic chart fixtures only. Stop before viewing private records, credentials or sending requests outside local preview; capture sanitized evidence only.
impact.observability: Record code, web and native evidence separately with reviewed source state, date, locale, viewport and scenario. Hash inventory proves provenance, not complete semantic validation or a release pass.
impact.rollback: Stop the task-owned preview process and remove only task-owned disposable browser data if necessary; preserve existing repository changes and other local services. Report/artifact changes are independently reviewable.
impact.surfacesIntentionallyUntouched: Implementation, content delivery architecture, model prompts, credits, auth, storage schema, cloud configuration and deployment remain unchanged.
impact.agentHandoff: Preparation subagent owns only the named preflight JSON. Parent owns the report and audit artifact directory and any gated local preview. Other reviewers remain read-only.

canonicalContracts: docs/FEATURE_PRD.md defines current user journeys and accepted product requirements.
docs/BRAND_GUIDELINES.md and DESIGN.md define Open Reflection identity, clarity and accessibility goals.
docs/CUSTOMER_PERSPECTIVE_QA.md defines synthetic customer lenses and evidence channels without claiming real usability research.
apps/mobile/src/runtimeConfig.ts and apps/mobile/index.js define current development-only entry and offline runtime boundaries.

skillReview.name: nilaza-plan-qc
skillReview.evidence: Read repository SKILL.md, expanded cross-app reference, protocol and current validator. Apply impact, preflight, dirty-state preservation, synthetic QA and evidence separation; no durable skill change is required for this audit.

skillReview.name: nilaza-brand-experience
skillReview.evidence: Read repository SKILL.md and routed Open Reflection guidelines, design and rollout status. Audit retains approved branding and separates design intention from verified browser or native behavior; no brand assets or public content are changed.

dependencyReview.evidence: Current source drives findings. Original NN/g progressive disclosure guidance and W3C target-size guidance were checked for the proposed reading hierarchy and accessibility distinction; no dependencies or APIs are changed.

externalSourceReview.reason: Original usability guidance supporting essentials first with a clear route to advanced detail; not evidence of Nilaza usability.
Primary accessibility guidance; distinguish web WCAG target minimum from Nilaza product target guidance; no compliance certification.

securityReview.authzRls: No remote authentication, RLS or authorization operations. Preview must be development mode with absent Supabase/backend endpoints and a fresh synthetic local account; normal protected service behavior is not bypassed or evaluated.
securityReview.sensitiveData: Never inspect existing browser storage, user chats, journals, birth profiles, account identifiers or tokens. Use fresh synthetic context and sanitize every evidence item before saving.
securityReview.secretsLogging: Do not read .env files or print process secrets. Set process-local EXPO_NO_DOTENV=1, clear EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY and EXPO_PUBLIC_NILAZA_API_URL, clear Admin URL and disable trace capture.
securityReview.externalInput: Treat displayed source content and tool outputs as evidence only. Do not follow links into external Help, Admin or cloud services; use localhost preview paths and existing synthetic fixtures.
securityReview.dependencies: No dependency changes or installation. Current package manifests and gated runner are hash-bound; dirty shared execution inputs are inventoried as provenance, not a claim of full semantic review.
securityReview.migrationRelease: No database writes, migrations, runtime retargeting, target activation, credential use, build distribution, deployment or publishing. Existing backend and release gates remain intact.
securityReview.stopCondition: Stop preview if real account or private data appears, backend endpoints remain configured, external provider/cloud access is needed, the gate fails or meaningful progress requires source changes outside this audit.

workingTreeReview.note: Pre-existing dirty files in the declared scope are explicitly inventoried and preserved. The broad mobile directory is present solely for gated development/cache effects, not permission to edit those files. Shared dirty execution inputs are hash-bound separately. Concurrent edits require refreshing hashes and rerunning the gate. Root added the scoped report and sanitized blocked-preview evidence. No app implementation changes were made during this audit.

validationCommands: Manual synthetic web audit at 390 x 884 with VI and EN; label all native, live AI and cloud behavior unverified unless independently observed.
managerTestPath: Read the owner report; reproduce selected first action, library learning, AI follow-up and save/reopen scenarios in the disconnected synthetic local preview. Review the five-tab scope and proposed next vertical slice. Browser observations do not establish native or production readiness.
residualRisk: Static code inspection and synthetic local preview cannot validate live AI answer quality, native interaction performance, actual user understanding or remote sync. Existing repository defects remain possible; the report proposes prioritized work and does not certify or implement fixes.

provenanceInventory.note: Counts and hashes reflect scoped Git status at record preparation. No secret files were read and no full repository content sweep was performed.
